notes: Phase 1 of Mobile Bottom Sheet Redesign implemented via strict Red-Green-Refactor TDD cycle. All 42 test files pass with zero failures. World-review identified critical accessibility issues: incomplete ARIA tab pattern (missing id/aria-controls), no focus return on close, no drag handle for discoverability. Addressed all actionable items: added ARIA id/aria-controls/aria-labelledby to tab buttons and panels, added focus return to hamburger button in closeSidebars(), added visual drag handle bar, added auto-switch to images tab when new images are added (file picker and drag-drop). Focus trapping and arrow key keyboard navigation deferred to Phase 2 per plan. SOLID review confirmed methods are minimal (SRP), no new imports (DIP), focused interfaces (ISP). Content duplication (bottom sheet mirrors sidebar content) is intentional per plan — Phase 3 migration will deduplicate.
